html:
Visiting Huong Quang Phu Cau Village and Handicraft Village, visitors will be able to admire with their own eyes the beauty and meticulous craftsmanship of the skillful hands of the Chuong people, a place famous for its thousand-year-old Korean conical hat making craft.

Coming here, visitors will discover the richness and diversity of exquisite products, from bundles of incense arranged in a shape that looks like a flower from afar, a check-in spot that many tourists seek when traveling to Lang Huong Quang Phu Cau. No matter what angle you stand at, visitors can take beautiful photos for themselves, just raise the camera and you will take beautiful photos.

Visiting the handmade process from the lacquer stage or the coatings of the ancient craft village, and the final stage is decorated very delicately, visitors can experience making hats with the people here.

With that eye-catching decoration, it has highlighted the beauty of a traditional craft village. Moreover, when coming here, visitors can also meet the artisans and learn about the unique cultural way of making conical hats of this craft village.

The incense making village has gone through many generations, and is still preserved and developed to this day.

To experience those interesting things, come with Vietlook Travel to Quang Phu Cau incense village today, visitors will be able to visit and explore the most interesting things that this place brings to visitors.

If you have the opportunity to travel to Hanoi, visitors should once set foot in Chuong conical hat village to visit and enjoy the scenery of a rustic and simple traditional craft village, but it exudes the unique beauty of a village.

Many visitors who come here have made conical hats with their own hands, with the people here, with the gentle and hospitable people will make visitors not want to leave, and when leaving, they will not forget to come back.

In particular, visitors can use lacquer to make their own hats or paint animal shapes according to their preferences. Many foreign visitors are often very excited to paint lacquer themselves.

It can be said that when coming to the craft village, besides the incense bundles or hats, visitors can also paint lacquer paintings in the shape of animals, and bring them back as souvenirs. It will be very interesting for your trip to visit Quang Phu Cau incense, Chuong village hats, and lacquer villages.
